verdict.rationale: AiPrise's marketing site claims ongoing re-screening against sanctions, PEP, watchlist and adverse-media data, and says monitoring feeds a live risk score that auto-flags cases for review, which analysts can then own. However, the re-screening claim names only businesses, UBOs and directors, not previously verified individual users. Nothing explains what triggers a re-screen or how change events are delivered. Missing for 10: re-screening of individual (KYC) users, triggers tied to watchlist updates and their frequency, programmatic change events (e.g., webhooks), in-depth docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on

citations.quote: Ongoing re-screening of business, UBOs, and directors against sanctions, PEP, watchlists, and adverse media.
Monitoring feeds a live risk score that auto-flags for review when it crosses your threshold.
Every case has an owner: assign to an analyst or route to Enhanced Due Diligence.
